messages:
oliver: Heads up — prod eu-gpu warm-pool is failing to join new nodes after last night's VPC firewall + KMS keystore rotation. Seeing node bootstrap decryption errors and keystore-proxy 403s. Anyone on call?

sara: ugh, saw a blip. can you paste the bootstrap logs?

oliver: logs (redacted):
```
[2026-03-21T01:12:04Z] keystore-proxy: decrypt failed key=arn:aws:kms:eu:... error=AccessDeniedException
[2026-03-21T01:12:04Z] node-bootstrap: keystore fetch 403 from keystore-proxy 10.45.3.12:8443
[2026-03-21T01:12:05Z] warm-pool-join: retries exhausted
```

mike: grafana/infra -> keystore-proxy request rate shot up during rotation window, plus audit-exporter started batching and pushing more S3 ops. link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/keystore/keystore-overview?panel=3

maria: two possibilities: 1) the KMS key policy change removed the node role decrypt permission, or 2) the new firewall default-deny blocked the keystore-proxy <-> kms controlplane egress. both would show similar symptoms.

sre-jen: cost note — warm-pool keeping pods in pending/backoff for 30+m means we keep reserved GPU instances warm and billed. seen ~3% increase in hourly committed cost for eu region since 01:00.

oliver: i can confirm the keystore-proxy logs show repeated SIG-403 for STS assume role calls. snippet: `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity denied for arn:aws:iam::nnn:role/keystore-node`

mike: can we temporarily add a firewall exception to allow the keystore-proxy subnet -> kms endpoints and keystore controlplane (10.45.0.0/18 -> 52.95.0.0/16 egress) while we dig root cause? will reduce failures immediately.

maria: i'd prefer narrow change: allow keystore-proxy IP range to keystore-kms-controlplane FQDNs and add a short-lived KMS policy rollback if policy change is the culprit. avoid broad egress.

ops-bot: Deploybot: rolled keystore-proxy v2.14.3 at 2026-03-21T00:58:12Z (change: kms-rotation-2026-03-21).

sre-jen: agreed on narrow firewall exception + verify KMS key policy. cost impact timeline: if nodes remain pending > 2h we'll hit next commit band. need fix < 60m.

sara: I can run a quick IAM simulation against the new KMS policy, and check the role trust relationship. giving me 20m.

oliver: plan proposal (quick):
1) apply firewall allow rule for keystore-proxy subnet -> keystore controlplane FQDNs for 30m (mike)
2) run IAM policy simulator on KMS key policy + role trust (sara)
3) if simulator fails, revert KMS policy to previous version and re-run join (maria)
4) follow up with audit log backfill and small postmortem if rollback needed (oliver)

mike: i'll open the firewall change, will tag it with temp-expiry 30m and monitor.

sara: running simulator now. quick output: node role missing kms:Decrypt on key alias/redwood-eu-llm-keystore. looks like a statement was removed in rotation.

maria: ok that confirms it — KMS rotation PR accidentally dropped the delegated kms:Decrypt statement for the node role. i'll prepare the rollback/patch. we should avoid firewall churn.

oliver: thanks. action owners: mike (firewall interim allow), sara (IAM sim + verify after patch), maria (KMS policy patch + rollback), oliver (postmortem + audit backfill). ETA: patch in 25-35m.

mike: temporary firewall rule applied (change/CHG-2026-412) — monitoring. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incidentbot: Keystore bootstrap failure alert resolved at 2026-03-21T01:03:40Z (automated checks passing).

sre-jen: warm-pool join rate returning to normal, cost drift reversing. will watch for 2h window and then close the incident.

oliver: filing quick postmortem draft in #postmortems after we confirm audit logs. thanks all. :heart:
